papers.title: CORR Insights®: What Is the Cumulative Incidence of Femoral Stem Revision and Stem Complication in Cemented and Uncemented Hip Arthroplasty for Proximal Femoral Metastatic Bone Disease?
papers.first_author_affiliation: Tripler Army Medical Center, Honolulu, HI, USA.; University of Hawaii Cancer Center, Honolulu, HI, USA.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注髋关节置换中股骨柄翻修的临床发生率，未涉及应力遮挡、微动、骨-植入物界面等生物力学建模或植入物设计。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not include any biomechanical modeling, finite element analysis, implant design optimization, or additive manufacturing; it is purely a clinical outcomes study.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估股骨近端转移瘤患者髋关节置换术后股骨柄翻修的累积发生率
summary_zh.method: 使用累积发生率分析对水泥型和非水泥型股骨柄的翻修及并发症风险进行量化
summary_zh.result: 非水泥柄翻修率显著高于水泥柄，但差异可能受患者选择偏倚影响
summary_zh.validation: 基于注册数据库的临床病例数据验证

summary_en.motivation: To determine the cumulative incidence of femoral stem revision and complications in cemented versus uncemented hip arthroplasty for proximal femoral metastatic disease.
summary_en.method: Cumulative incidence analysis was used to compare revision and complication rates between cemented and uncemented stems.
summary_en.result: Uncemented stems had a significantly higher revision rate than cemented stems, though patient selection bias may confound the comparison.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed using clinical registry data from a large cohort.
